items.title: Why Charter (CHTR) Stock Is Falling Today
items.summary: Shares of cable, internet, and telephone services provider Charter (NASDAQ:CHTR) fell 4.5% in the afternoon session after the company announced that Chief Financial Officer Jessica Fischer will step down from her role. According to a company press release, Fischer's resignation is effective October 15, as she relocates for another professional opportunity. items.title: Charter Communications (CHTR) Names Kevin Howard Interim CFO
items.summary: Charter Communications (NasdaqGS:CHTR) announced that CFO Jessica Fischer is stepping down, and Kevin Howard has been appointed as interim CFO. The executive change follows multiple recent Board shifts related to Liberty Broadband's merger and new appointments from Cox Enterprises. Taken together, these leadership moves represent a key transition period for Charter Communications' governance and senior finance team.
